name: Yue Ying Bieshu
source:
● I transmigrated into a game world, only to find myself as a supporting female character!
● This is a world with vampires, and I am an apprentice vampire hunter!
● I am forced to live under the same roof with my enemy! And he is a half-human, half-vampire.
● What? I can't change the original plot! But what about him, who is so important to me... I can't accept his ending as it is!
● The original male lead, or the original villain, whom should I choose?
● Should I choose my past lover and never let him down, or should I live well in this life and never look back?
[Translated from [url=https://www.taptap.cn/app/213627/]TapTap[/url]]
